No celestial disks or stars in frame. No atmosphere, clouds, plume, exposed ocean, biology, astronaut, spacecraft or implication of survivable landing. Never use Moon, Mars, Pluto or any other body's geography or recoloured skin. Material fractions, chemistry, roughness, blocks, topography, exposure, colour and light are imagined. Keep the artwork plausible but illustrative, with no diagnostic feature registration. Add a clear legible footer exactly 'IMAGINED · LOCAL VIEW OF DIONE' and a smaller second line 'Terrain, materials and lighting are illustrative'. Scientific context artwork for the Fidelity astronomy viewer.
